properties.description: Spanish language tutoring service

properties.text: My daughter has had Spanish tuition with Poncho Spanish for several years now and is currently working towards a Spanish IGCSE. The tuition is excellent! The lessons are fun and engaging, and being able to practice speaking Spanish with the tutor has really helped my daughter pick up extra vocabulary and great pronunciation. If you are looking for Spanish tuition, then I would thoroughly recommend Poncho!

properties.full_text: My girls have been doing online Poncho Spanish lessons for sometime now and they absolutely love their lessons, they are always fun and playful and super well prepared. The most amazing thing is that they are as effective as they are fun. The girls both had an A* in Spanish as soon as they started the language in grade seven in school and are holding whole conversation on our holidays in Spain. I am truly impressed. Not only that they continuously love their lessons but also with the results. What a success, I can highly recommend Poncho Spanish.

properties.description: Children achieved A* in Spanish at grade seven in school after taking Poncho Spanish lessons
Children can hold whole conversations during holidays in Spain

properties.text: Anto has been tutoring my son for the past 3 years now, she is so friendly and professional. My son used to struggle getting on with teachers but Anto has an amazing bond with my son. Her lessons and fun and very informative, he had learnt so much.

Whilst I was initially apprehensive as to how my son (7) would cope with zoom sessions, after a trial session he is thoroughly enjoying his lessons with Anto. She is so good with the children and such a lovely soul. Patient and full of encouragement. I'm very happy with the service provided and with how the lessons are presented. I have zero complaints and my child is thriving.

properties.description: Teacher described as good with children, patient, encouraging, lovely soul

properties.text: Anto is lovely, so welcoming and enthusiastic. My daughter is really enjoying her online lessons and gaining confidence in herself and understanding of Spanish.
